profile.headline: Sr Software Developer
profile.summary: A highly accomplished professional with extensive experience in application design, architecture, and development. Expertise in leading development teams and project planning. Proficient in object-oriented, SOA, and microservices methodologies, with a strong background in developing enterprise-level web applications using ASP.NET, .NET MVC, and .NET Core. Skilled in integrating AI-driven solutions, leveraging OpenAI and Azure AI APIs to enhance automation, natural language processing, and predictive analytics in enterprise applications. Certified Scrum Master and AWS Cloud Practitioner with exceptional communication skills and a knack for solving complex problems with elegant solutions that drive business excellence. Passionate about leveraging AI technologies to optimize workflows, improve user experiences, and drive innovation in modern software development.

projects.title: NPI Management Tool
projects.description:
NPI Management Tool is an integrated web-based system that allows individuals across the enterprise to access information they need to execute their NPI programs. Teams can effectively collaborate through NPI Management Tool because multiple users can input and view information.  As the single safe source for entering and storing supporting information, team members simply attach and store finalized files for long term documentation. 

Team members are designated to certain activities, which drives accountability beyond the NPI Manager.  Automatic email notifications are sent either to the entire team or select members as relevant.  The NPI Management Tool is proactive because it provides notifications of what to do at the beginning of a phase at an individual level. NPI Managers can view the program status all the time through the Assessment tool. 

NPI Management Tool includes the following:

NPI Registration/Activation Tool (Key Dates, and Team management, Deliverable, SN Prefix and Arrangement,  selection)
NPI Activity Assessment Tool
Automatic Email Notifications (with user Preferences)
NPI Dashboard
NPI Reports
